notes.title: Nov-29-2024 minor patch
notes.notes:
Cotroller now immediately works after exiting Clear Data screen.
SFX of ship moving no longer mutes after a g-pulse.
Minor dificulty tweak.
Minor Music and SFX fix.

notes.title: April 1 update notes:
notes.notes:
Various small fixes.
Player no longer accidentally boosts when changing controls with the boost button.

notes.title: March 25 patch 2:
notes.notes:
Small sound effects fix.
Lasers now sound properly.

notes.title: March 25 update notes:
notes.notes:
Minor SFX fixes. Some muted sounds can be heard now.
Last level visuals tweaked for easier navigation.

notes.title: March 24 patch notes:
notes.notes:
Warp sound fix.
Training Gpulse message appear properly.

notes.title: March 13 patch 3 notes.
notes.notes:
GPulse speed tweaked.
Music track added for Labyris.
Lifeline now uses a remixed track.

notes.title: March 23 patch 2 note:
notes.notes: Minor oversight fixed. Final level hints now correctly show.

notes.title: March 22 Update:
notes.notes:
Dificulty tweak.
Simplex now only requires one switch to proceed.
CircleX 2 has been divided into two areas.
Various sound and music tweaks.

notes.title: March, 21 update notes:
notes.notes:
Audio has been tweaked for more even sounds.
Volume keys no longer switch control method when using joystick during gameplay.

notes.title: March 20 Update notes:
notes.notes:
Added a Training mode. Accessible on the title screen.
 Meteos 3 was divided into 2 areas for higher accessibility.
 Pressing a button is now necessary to switch control method during gameplay.
 Audio sfx tweak.
 Minor UI audio teak.
 Fixed UI bug that prevented menu navigation on joystick after switching controls if the switch happened while the mouse was hovering an option.
 Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Notes for march 15 update 2:
notes.notes: Default settings now work properly when no settings files is found or when running for the first time.

notes.title: March 15 patch notes:
notes.notes:
Sound rebalance and fix. 
Throttle sfx fix after g-pulse.

notes.title: Patch notes for March 13 update:
notes.notes: Small fixes. Luminous 2 was tweaked to greatly decrease player downtime.

notes.title: Update for March 11, 2:00 am est.
notes.notes: Minor fixes for UI and audio. Overly loud sfx fixed.
